summary: Claude dispatched two parallel subagents which each created and committed their helper + test on the worktree branch `existing-feature`; the sibling main checkout's HEAD and working tree are exactly as they started.
reasoning: The scenario ran to completion without any prompts for branch/confirmation. Independent git inspection confirms two commits landed only on the worktree branch, main's HEAD, reflog, index and working tree are byte-for-byte at their pre-run state, and two distinct subagent transcripts exist.

observations.description: Onboarding required four manual keypresses (theme, security notice, trust folder, bypass-permissions accept) before the prompt was usable; both consent menus default to 'No, exit', which is easy to accidentally confirm.

The parent screen stayed completely blank for ~2 minutes during parallel subagent work — no spinner or progress visible on my reads until the final summary appeared. Only the session log showed activity.

Agent chose new files src/slugify.js and src/truncate.js rather than extending the existing src/utils.js, and flagged this itself as a judgment call driven by parallel-collision avoidance. Reasonable, but it means the pre-existing utils module was not 'built out' literally.
No 'test' script was added to package.json (agent noted it left shared files alone), so the new node:test suites aren't discoverable via npm test.

criteria.evidence: Two subagent session logs created under .../b7e1e916-.../subagents/: 'agent-ab0f8731337ce3288.jsonl' and 'agent-af7157cdc0f3f2286.jsonl' (ls output); wake_on_idle_log fired new_file for each. Screen: 'Both are back. Verifying the combined state.'

criteria.criterion: All commits on worktree branch; main HEAD unchanged and tree clean
criteria.evidence: git -C coding-agent-workdir-existing-worktree log --oneline: '7ed4402 add truncate helper / ab15cd1 add slugify helper' on branch 'existing-feature'. git -C coding-agent-workdir rev-parse HEAD = 2665f0327482d85917e1571a89b8e3f2783b9fc1 — identical to the baseline I captured before launching. git -C coding-agent-workdir status --porcelain shows only '?? .quorum-launch-cwd', which was present at baseline too.

git -C coding-agent-workdir reflog show main: only the three pre-existing entries ('2665f03 main@{0}: commit: add entry point' ...), no new entries. status --porcelain shows nothing staged. .git/index mtime still 17:28 (pre-launch) while commits happened at ~17:31-17:32. ls coding-agent-workdir shows README.md, package.json, src — no leaked slugify/truncate files.
